preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The sum of all n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(p, list) and len(p) == n for n, p in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the result is a list of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= x <= n-1 for x in p) for n, p in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: Each element in the permutation is between 0 and n-1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(p)) == n for n, p in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: Each permutation contains n distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all((p[i] + i)**0.5 == int((p[i] + i)**0.5) for i in range(n)) for n, p in zip(test_cases, results) if p != [-1])
postconditions.description: For each valid permutation, p[i] + i is a perfect square for all valid indices i.

postconditions.expression: all(p == [-1] for n, p in zip(test_cases, results) if not all((p[i] + i)**0.5 == int((p[i] + i)**0.5) for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, the result is [-1].
